name: Ring of Courage
body:
Price 14,400 gp; Aura faint abjuration; CL 8; Weight –

This ring bears imagery of bears and lions along its band. The wearer of this ring can activate this ring with a command word to grant 3 allies within 30 feet with the benefits of remove fear.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 7,200 gp; Feats Forge Ring, remove fear
